notes: Two independent properties, neither weakened for the other. Phase A: with no override the dirty tree refuses before any bundle or sandbox exists, and a control shows ignored files alone never refuse. Phase B: under the explicitly recorded gate-local --ignore-uncommitted equivalent, only refs/heads/dca-g10-selected is bundled, verified and delivered by sbx cp into one mountless --skills=off sandbox from the pinned Claude base. The second branch is proven absent by identity (no ref, git cat-file -e on its unique commit fails, not in git rev-list --all, canary absent), not by wording. Phase A mirrors launcher-cli precondition 2 with a gate-local observation; the launcher and its ref parser are T064. Canary values are never recorded: the evidence carries IDs and match counts only. The sandbox is removed by name; sbx rm --all and sbx reset are never used.
